review.summary: Attempt 3 closes five of the six residual attempt-2 findings with executed, source-bound evidence. baseline_ledger() now hash-binds contracts/manifest.json's gitTreeLedgerSha256 and the 0.34.0 commit before deriving the three-file runtime delta, with a tamper test; the SDK freeze compares the full cached+untracked path set against 578f2e6; a locked-Zod range test was added; committed-history hygiene was registered; and the response-tolerance divergence is now explicitly slated for CHANGELOG/STABILITY. Provenance remains strong: commit object -> complete 699-file tree -> each of seven pinned blobs, inventory equality, symlink/traversal rejection, pinned manifest digest. Checks receipt c2172eb4 is genuine (8 commands, exit 0, 9/51/26 tests run) and bound to source 95f6cc26. Residual defects are cosmetic or defense-in-depth: one uncorrected prose typo, a freeze assertion gated on fingerprint-excluded phase-status data, and vacuous whitespace coverage of the untracked deliverables.

findings.description: The planning-phase SDK freeze - the only guard that keeps phase 26 implementation-free - is gated on `self.status['active_phase'] == 26`, read from docs/phase-status.json, which review_phase.fingerprint deliberately excludes (tools/review_phase.py:16 EXCLUDED_FILES). A full `check_phase.py --phase 26` run does require the active phase (tools/check_phase.py:845), but `--verification-only` does not and still writes docs/checks/phase-26.json with no `scope` key, so a report produced while active_phase named another command-defined phase (e.g. 23) would skip the path-set and byte comparisons yet still satisfy check_evidence (tools/review_phase.py:210-216) after the status file is set back to 26. No executed check binds active_phase to the reviewed fingerprint.
findings.required_fix: Derive the freeze condition from immutable data rather than phase-status: assert the 578f2e6 crates/scm-sdk path set and bytes unconditionally in this module (it is only registered in commands_for(26)), or add an explicit `self.assertEqual(self.status['active_phase'], 26)` plus a scope marker on --verification-only reports so they cannot qualify a phase review.

findings.description: The prose-spacing fix claimed at docs/phase-status.json:6823 ('corrected prose spacing') is incomplete: line 65 still reads 'chunks >=42 (target45)'. Every other instance flagged by attempt 2 (plan:161-162,169,199; docs/PHASES.md:278,280; the disposition strings) is corrected, so this is the single residual occurrence in the chunk's primary deliverable, and the disposition slightly overstates completion.
findings.required_fix: Insert the missing space ('target 45') at docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:65.

findings.description: The newly added committed-history hygiene command is currently vacuous: HEAD is 578f2e6 (docs/checks/phase-26-private-material.json:5), so `git diff --check 578f2e6..HEAD` compares a commit with itself (recorded empty output, 0.002s). `git diff --check` and `--cached --check` cover only the six modified tracked files, so none of this chunk's new artifacts - docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md, tools/verify_typescript035_source.py, tools/test_typescript035_governance.py, contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/** - are whitespace-checked, all being untracked in the reviewed state. The plan prose is now accurately narrowed (plan:215), so this is residual coverage rather than a false claim, and no executed check asserts the new command's presence in commands_for(26).
findings.required_fix: Add an `--others --exclude-standard` whitespace pass over new untracked artifacts (or re-run hygiene after committing them) and assert the presence of the baseline..HEAD command in tools/test_typescript035_governance.py, following the MANAGEMENT_BASELINE assertion at tools/test_management_phases.py:427.

findings.description: The plan promises that 'absence or mismatch of that guard blocks advancement' for the phase-28 0.2.4 delivery verification (docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:178-180), but nothing fails closed today: the delivery branch is restricted to phases 20/24 (:466-468), and phase 28 would complete through the ordinary advance path once its command set is registered. By contrast, commands_for(27)/(28) do fail closed (tools/check_phase.py:755), showing the pattern is available.
findings.required_fix: Register a placeholder fail-closed branch now - e.g. raise in the advance path when args.phase == 28 until a version-specific 0.2.4 release_delivery.verify call exists - and assert it in tools/test_typescript035_governance.py.

findings.description: Switching active_phase to 26 while phase 24 stays 'in_progress' and 25 'pending' leaves no tool-supported return path: review_phase.main refuses non-active phases (:493), and next_phase returns None for phase 28 via final_in_sequence (:417-420), so completing this sequence sets active_phase to null with two incomplete phases. The non-reset intent is documented (docs/PHASES.md:272-274), but neither the plan nor PHASES.md states how 24/25 are later reactivated, and no check binds the active_phase switch to the recorded authorization string at :6782.
findings.required_fix: Document the resumption procedure (explicit maintainer re-selection of active_phase 24 after phase 28, with its existing fail-closed requirements unchanged) in docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md and docs/PHASES.md, and assert in tools/test_typescript035_governance.py that active_phase is one of the authorized values while phases 24/25 remain incomplete.

evidence: Prior medium finding closed with code and a test: tools/verify_typescript035_source.py:13-21 now reads contracts/manifest.json, requires sha256(contracts/sources/typescript/git-tree.json) == baseline.gitTreeLedgerSha256 (the same value verify-contracts.py:305 enforces) and ledger['commit'] == 4a80dbdb3dc14365e1c25d838ac0bd139485d48c before verify() derives the src/ delta at :56-61; tools/test_typescript035_governance.py:20-31 copies both files, appends a byte and asserts ValueError matching 'baseline tree ledger'.

The passing receipt is real and source-bound: docs/reviews/phase-26-chunk-plan-and-provenance-attempt-03.checks.json records phase 26, passed true, source_sha256 95f6cc262d01bb3f35fc3cc3b7a21a23608e876250a66dd81c818c9b6b07e7f5 (equal to the reviewed source), no 'scope' key, a command list byte-equal to commands_for(26) at tools/check_phase.py:313-322, all eight exit_code 0 and timeout false, with stderr showing 9 governance, 51 review-phase and 26 management-phase tests actually executed; tools/check_phase.py:83-91 would have failed an empty discovery. docs/checks/phase-26.json is the same report.

limitations: Read-only Read/Glob/Grep with no shell: I recomputed no SHA-256, SHA-1, Git blob or tree hash. The reviewed fingerprint 95f6cc26..., checks digest c2172eb4..., MANIFEST_SHA256 89831a8c... and per-file digests were assessed for internal consistency and for what the code does with them. I could not re-run the eight phase-26 commands; I assessed the recorded receipt plus the code those commands execute.

I could not diff against 578f2e6 myself, so the attempt-2 to attempt-3 delta was reconstructed from current file contents, the prior review's cited line ranges and the recorded dispositions; docs/PHASES.md and docs/implementation-plan.md remain unbound by any executed byte-freeze (only the source fingerprint covers them).

Upstream commit 780c985cac90144ea1884fe6cffa58b5deec9ac4 cannot be authenticated offline. The pin proves internal Git-object consistency (commit -> complete 699-file tree -> each pinned blob) at parity with the enforced 0.34.0 standard, not that this commit is the published upstream release. No .local/typescript checkout exists and none is required.

Phase 27/28 acceptance was not assessed and is not a deliverable here: the additive overlay, contracts/typescript-035-parity.json and its oracle, the 12-node ancestor closure count, the directional corpus, regeneration determinism, and the 0.2.4 readiness/delivery guards are declared later obligations, and their chunk scope_evidence (docs/phase-status.json:6835-6860, 6896-6921) is registration rather than completion. No Rust, generator or oracle execution exists yet by design.

Milestone 3's pre-implementation plan reviews live outside the gated review path (docs/reviews/typescript-035/plan-attempt-1..3.json); only attempt 3 has a CLI envelope, and no tool verifies these records. They are excluded from the fingerprint (docs/reviews/) and cannot be mistaken for gate evidence by accepted_chunks, but they are not independently verifiable the way the phase-26 chunk records are.

I did not read any credential or tenant-registration file, the external registration config, or anything outside this repository. I grepped only key names in contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/test/models/fixtures/directional-security-profile.json (csp_id, dlp_tenant_id, profile_id, tsg_id), relying on the byte/blob pin plus the allowlist at tools/verify_typescript035_source.py:86-89 for its identifier inventory.
